name: clips/t3_river_oner
prompt: One continuous first-person POV shot, no cuts. The camera walks slowly and steadily straight forward down the middle of the flooded riverside path in heavy rain, always facing straight ahead, gentle natural walking bob, the thin hood rim at the top of frame. The water on the path gets deeper, splashing softly with each step. Halfway through, a bright flash of lightning lights the whole scene: across the river on the far embankment to the right stands one very tall, still figure, only a dark silhouette. Darkness. A second flash: the far bank is empty. The camera stops walking, then tilts slowly straight down to your own white sneakers standing ankle-deep in dark rippling water, rain hitting the surface, and holds there. Never show a face or the body from outside. Realistic, cinematic 35mm film look, no text.
